correctness.rationale: The 25 tetrahedral facets of the orthogonal free sum have strict slack at all nonincident vertices, so each persists with its orientation. Every ridge of these retained facets is already paired and the facet adjacency graph of a convex polytope is connected; thus there is no missing facet. The interior origin also persists, giving the sum of signed simplex determinants divided by 24. For the angular contribution, an in-plane component has angle shift t*alpha_i+O(t^3) and radius 1-t^2*||u_i||^2/2+O(t^3). Expanding adjacent wedge areas cancels the angular first-order terms and gives the five-cycle Laplacian. The mixed derivative of the first cycle is sum_i u_i wedge (a_{i+1}-a_{i-1})=2 sin(theta) sum_i u_i wedge J a_i, so only its first-harmonic projection U contributes; similarly only W contributes for the second cycle. The mixed cross sign and scale follow by expanding det([[I,tW],[tU,I]])=1-t^2 tr(UW)+O(t^4), multiplied by the product (5 sin(theta))^2. With the sphere normalization the off-plane loss is exactly the square in RESULT.md; its antisymmetric mixed directions are orbit directions. The factors 5 sin^2(theta)/48 on the angular Laplacian eigenvalues and 5 sin^2(theta)/24 and 5 sin^2(theta)/12 on residual and symmetric mixed modes give precisely the listed half-Hessian bands and multiplicities 6,4,12,4,4. After nearest-orthogonal alignment the displacement is orthogonal to the orbit tangent, so its leading sphere-chart tangent displacement is normal and its squared norm is asymptotic to D. The uniform quadratic expansion and the first angular harmonic give the lower estimate and its matching limiting ratio. These are analytic checks, independent of the recorded numerical tolerances.
residual_risks: The bound is local and uses labelled chordal squared distance to the common orthogonal orbit. The ordinary Hessian is twice the quadratic coefficient, not the same operator normalization.
